name: schedule-coordinator-editor-every-class

steps.name: 01-editor-every-class
steps.instruction:
the teacher editor is breaking on my grade 12 classes. if i pick 12.9 and try to add a lesson for a teacher at period 7 it throws Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'wk') and nothing is added, and the period list it offers is wrong anyway, grade 12 finish at period 6 and then have the supplementary slot. the grade 9/10/11 editing works today and has to keep working exactly as it is.

make the editor work the same way for every class. each class runs on the bell grid it is listed under in the data file, and the office sends me a new grid most years when they change a stream, so nothing can be tied to the two grids we have now. the editor must only let a lesson go into a period that class really has, and when it hasn't got that period it should say so instead of dying. the clock times of a lesson are the ones that class runs on the day the lesson is on. a double is one lesson from the start of its own period through to the end of the period that comes next in that class's day, and if nothing comes after it that day then it can't be a double at all.

the other half is i need it to stop me double booking. the class can't be in two lessons at the same time and a teacher can't be in two places at once, and that means both what is in the class timetables and what is in the teacher's own week that we import from the teacher app. only count it as a clash when the two things are really running at the same time, one finishing exactly as the other starts is normal here. a teacher is whoever the chinese characters at the front of the written name say they are, the english spelling after is just how people type it, and two teachers are the same person only when that chinese part is exactly the same. if it won't go in then nothing changes at all, no half added lesson and nothing left in anybody's week. the wording for every one of these refusals is already in the app, the engine just never says any of it.

the Week of box on the add form does nothing at the moment. some things in a teacher's own week only happen on alternate weeks (par 1 is odd weeks, par 2 is even weeks) and the date i type there is what should decide it: weeks run monday to sunday and week 1 is the week holding the first thursday of january, like the printed calendar, so odd numbered weeks get the odd ones and even numbered weeks the even ones, and the same date has to mean the same week whatever the clock on the machine is set to. if i leave the date empty, treat the alternate week things as on. if what i typed isn't a real day on the calendar, say that and add nothing.

and when a lesson does go in it has to turn up in that teacher's own week at the same clock time the class timetable gives it, that is the whole point of this editor.

everything is in /app/repo, python3 build.py rebuilds the html i hand out.
